item.title: Landlord Fined $59K For Westville Eyesore
item.description: A Livable City Initiative (LCI) hearing officer approved the Elicker administration's request on Thursday to impose $59,000 in anti-blight fines on the owner of a long-dilapidated building at the "gateway" to Westville. The post Landlord Fined $59K For Westville Eyesore appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: NHPS Parent: School “Mishandled” Alleged Assault’s Warning Signs, Aftermath
item.description: Nearly two years after first raising concerns about how the city's school district responds to student-on-student abuse, Anika Russell is still looking for answers about what went wrong in the lead up to one of her children -- then an eighth-grader at Benjamin Jepson School -- being bullied and allegedly sexually assaulted by a classmate. The post NHPS Parent: School “Mishandled” Alleged Assault’s Warning Signs, Aftermath appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: Amid Nationwide Protests, Anti-ICErs Rally Downtown
item.description: High school senior Charlotte Stover joined over 200 people protesting immigration enforcement outside City Hall early Friday afternoon. Stover wasn’t at school because she wanted to participate in a national “blackout” in solidarity with immigrants and activists — and because she kept thinking of “all the little kids being taken away from their families.” The post Amid Nationwide Protests, Anti-ICErs Rally Downtown appeared first on New Haven Independent.
